## About
Wycliffe Automotive is a family-owned and operated auto repair shop on the Katy Freeway in West Houston. We look after drivers from the Energy Corridor, Memorial, Spring Branch and Katy, whether you bring in a daily driver or a weekend project.
We handle just about everything your car needs under one roof, from oil changes, brakes and tires to A/C, transmissions, electrical, cooling, engine work, steering and suspension, auto painting and Texas emissions inspections. Domestic or foreign, every car gets the same care and the same straight answers.
You get a clear estimate before any work begins, and the work is done by people who live and work in West Houston.

## Services
- Oil changes: Fast oil changes with quality oil and filters built to protect your engine.
- A/C repair: A full diagnosis, not just a top-off. We test for leaks and work on compressors, condensers and evaporators.
- Brake service: Squeaks, grinding or a soft pedal. We handle pads, rotors, calipers and complete brake jobs.
- New and used tires: Mounting, balancing, rotations and flat repairs, with honest advice and no upsell.
- Check engine diagnostics: We read the codes and find the real problem before you pay for parts.
- Emissions inspection: Harris County requires an annual emissions inspection to renew your registration, and we take care of it here.
- Transmission repair: Slipping gears, rough shifts or a delay pulling out, caught before a small issue becomes a rebuild.
- Batteries and alternators: Dead batteries, failing alternators and wiring faults that leave you stranded.
- Radiators and water pumps: Radiators, water pumps, hoses and coolant to keep your engine from overheating in Houston traffic.
- Engine trouble: Odd noises, leaks, fuel-pump and performance problems, diagnosed straight and fixed only where needed.
- Steering and suspension: Shocks, struts, steering and the wear behind pulls and clunks.
- Tune-up: Spark plugs, filters, fluids and inspections to catch small issues early.
- Panel painting and touch-ups: Color-matched repaints that bring back your car's finish after scratches, fade and chips.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on foreign and luxury cars?
A: Yes. We service domestic and foreign vehicles, including trucks, sedans, SUVs and European makes, with the same diagnostic process for all of them.

Q: Will I know the cost before you start?
A: Yes. We diagnose first, then give you a clear quote before any work starts.

Q: How long does A/C service take?
A: A recharge and leak check are often done the same day. Bigger jobs like a compressor or evaporator can take longer depending on parts, and we tell you the timeline when you drop off.
